available_nonresidual_summary.packet_mixture: largest at small transitions and contracts to ~0.02-0.03 at largest transitions

qualitative_late_witness.statement: Stage D froze rebound after mixture/covariance had become comparatively small; this witness is not used to define a residual-blind rank stratum.

A.reason: The consumed durable A surface anchors the full diagnostic files by SHA256 but does not expose per-transition arrays needed to apply the predeclared lower-half rank rule without reconstructing or rerunning upstream diagnostics.

G.phase: 5 phases x 3 orientations are frozen Cartesian strata at every radius; preserved balanced

transition_burden_definitions.covariance_concentration: max leading-eigen share across transition endpoints

cross_arm.reason: A strict residual-blind rank stratum cannot be instantiated on the persisted Stage-G summary, and the G strict nuisance-light radii have no verified nuisance-light A partners under the Stage-E scale contract.

selection_contract.orientation_rule: G preserves frozen orientation balance; A has no orientation axis in this carrier and nothing is imputed
selection_contract.phase_rule: preserve frozen phase balance; do not select phases by residual magnitude
selection_contract.rank_rule: within each arm and nuisance observable, select the lowest ceil(n/2) burden entries; ties by later radius ascending; strict nuisance-light stratum is intersection of all available non-residual burden selections
